alt_texts: Two wild sarus cranes with red heads standing in grass at Keoladeo National Park, India, headline 'The tallest flying bird is as tall as you'
A pair of wild sarus cranes calling with bills pointed skyward, with the statistic 1.8 m standing height
An adult sarus crane with a red head and a brown-headed juvenile beside a lake at Jawai Bandh, Rajasthan, with text on their farmland and wetland habitat
Wild sarus crane dancing with wings spread in Keoladeo National Park, with text on pairs dancing and trumpeting
Two juvenile sarus cranes with brown heads walking by a lake at Jawai Bandh, Rajasthan, with text on nests and eggs
Wild sarus crane standing in grass at Keoladeo National Park, with text on its Vulnerable IUCN status
Adult sarus crane feeding a juvenile in shallow water at Lumbini, Nepal, closing slide with sources and photo credits
